name: Shutaro
source:
When things go wrong, Shutaro is who you want by your side. Tough, by the books and trustworthy, Shutaro is the ideal Knight. Shutaro is on assignment from a rival corporation.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.cops]Google Play[/url]]
